aheadSummary: Plan published, few exact dates. There is no 2027 calendar. The UNA VOZ 27 page sets out an evangelism plan month by month to Nov 2027, with simultaneous campaigns in every church in Sep 2027 (the conference's part in the world church's OneVoice27 harvest). Its stages have months, not days. The one exact-date event is the Women's Ministries cruise, Jul 11-17, 2027.

events.title: UNA VOZ 27: preparatory evangelistic series in local churches
events.note: Short series of three to seven nights, set by each church, to present Jesus and learn what must be strengthened before September (stage 3, Sow and Cultivate, Apr-Jun 2027).

events.title: Women's Ministries cruise
events.place: Symphony of the Seas, sailing from Galveston, TX (Costa Maya, Cozumel, Roatan)
events.note: Devotionals and sessions on board; interior cabins from $865 per person (double occupancy). Also on the 2026 calendar page.

events.title: UNA VOZ 27: forty days of prayer and personal invitation
events.note: Daily prayer for each member's MIS CINCO list and for Bible students; personal invitations come first, digital media only support them. The world church's OneVoice27 40 days of prayer (Jul 23-Aug 31, 2027) is in above.json.

events.title: UNA VOZ 27: simultaneous evangelistic campaigns (nine messages)
events.note: Every church preaches a nine-message series centred on Jesus and Bible hope, with follow-up during the campaign. Public harvest of the Oct 2026-Nov 2027 project; a 90-day discipleship path follows in Oct-Nov 2027.

notes: There is no 2027 calendar page (/2027-calendar-of-events/ returns 404). The 2026 calendar page ends with the Dec 21, 2026-Jan 2, 2027 office closure, plus the Jul 2027 cruise.

UNA VOZ 27 month-by-month plan, Apr-Sep 2027: April digital mission (training youth and adults as digital missionaries), May Bible studies, June preparatory series, July team training (reception, hospitality, prayer, Bible study, decisions, baptism, children, media, discipleship), August forty days of prayer and invitation, September simultaneous campaigns. April, May and July are emphases or local training with no event and are left here; June, August and September are listed as events (month precision). Oct-Nov 2027 is the discipleship stage.
